title: Splash
prompt: Mobile splash: full-bleed photo of maize leaves at golden-yellow sunset, centered round logo seal 'Farmers and Government Partnership for Agricultural Growth' with handshake, large white wordmark 'NigerAgri' in condensed light display font, bottom full-width dark 'Start' button.

title: Sign up
prompt: Mobile sign-up over dark sunset wheat-field photo with scrim. Title 'Welcome to NigerAgri' (condensed, white). Transparent inputs with thin light border: First name (John), Last name (Doe), Phone number (+2345678901234), Password with hint 'At least 8 characters, with a number and a letter.', Confirm password. Dark 'Create account' button, terms text with blue 'Terms of Service' and 'Privacy Policy' links, 'Already have an account? Log In'.

title: Log in
prompt: Mobile login over blurred green farm photo. Title 'Welcome back to NigerAgri'. Inputs Phone Number, Password. Logo seal centered below. Dark 'Log In' button, terms text with blue links, 'Forgot password?' link.

title: Create Farmer ID — Step 1
prompt: Mobile 'Create your Farmer ID' step 1 of 3 (first segment green). Heading + subtitle 'Register once, and stay connected to Niger Foods, machinery, programmes and guaranteed markets.' Inputs with icons: Full name (Musa Danjuma), Phone (0803 000 0000), Community (Bida Central), LGA dropdown, Farm location 'Tap to capture GPS', Farm size 12.4, Main crops chips (Maize selected, Rice, Soybean, Sugarcane, Vegetables, Cassava), Farming experience dropdown '5 years', consent checkbox 'I agree to Niger Foods data & privacy terms.', dark 'Continue →'.

title: Farmer Home
prompt: Mobile farmer home. 'Good morning, John' + badge 'NI-00284921'. 'MY FARM' hero card: maize field aerial photo, overlay 'MAIZE · OBA SUPER 6', '12.4 Hectares', footer 'Sowing (Jun 14)' 'Day 42 of 126 · 33%' green progress bar, 'View Farm →'. 'WHAT YOU NEED TO DO' dark cards: 'Fertilize in 3 days' (Due Sunday 07:00 AM), 'Agronomist visit' (Friday 10:00 AM · Engr. Bello M.), 'Tractor service' (Slot confirmed (Morning)). Produce photo banner. 'NIGER FOODS SUPPORT' grouped panel: Fertilizer delivered (check), Tractor confirmed, Weather advisory sent (NEW). Payout panel: dark 'Est. Total Payout ₦68,000' with '8.5 TONNES' pill, milestone rows Tasseling & Pollination (Day 60), Harvest Window (Oct 20), Aggregation & Instant Payment (FINAL). Dark cards 'Bida Extension Hotline' (0800-NIGER) and 'Ask Agrit' (Hausa · Yoruba · English · Igbo, Speak). Bottom nav Home active.

title: Profile + NigerAgri ID
prompt: Mobile profile. Dark Farmer ID card: 'Farmer ID', badge NI-00284921, 'Musa Danjuma', QR tile, '12.4 Ha Land active', 'Bida LGA'. Stat tiles: 2 Farms, 1 Programme, 2024 Member since. 'PERSONAL INFORMATION' rows: Phone, Community Bida Central, LGA Bida, Niger State. 'MY FARMS' row 'Farm 01 · Bida Basin — 12.4 Ha · Maize Outgrower'. Rows Documents & receipts, Settings, Help & support, red 'Log out'. Bottom nav Profile active.

title: Farm detail
prompt: Mobile 'Farm' detail. Hero photo of crop rows with '12.4 Hectares'. Dark segmented tabs Overview (active) / Timeline / Inputs. Stat tiles: Crop White Maize, Sown Jun 14, 2025, Harvest Oct 20, 2025, Soil moisture 68%. Growth stage card Day 42 of 126, 33% complete. 'SEASON TIMELINE': Land preparation (done), Sowing (done), Fertilizer application (current), 4 Tasseling & pollination, 5 Harvest & aggregation. Dark 'Request a field visit'. Bottom nav Farm active.

title: Scan plant
prompt: Mobile plant scanner: full-bleed blurred crop photo, header 'Scan' with back and refresh round buttons, framed camera viewport with rounded corners, helper text 'Point the camera and scan the plant, make sure it is clearly visible', dark 'Scan Plant' button.

title: Create Farmer ID — Step 2 Farm & crops (progress 2/3)
prompt: Mobile screen 'Create your Farmer ID' step 2 of 3 (progress bar with 3 segments, first two filled green). Back chevron + centered title. Heading 'Your farm'. Fields with leading icons: Farm name ('Farm 01 · Bida Basin'), LGA dropdown, Ward/Community, 'Tap to capture GPS' input with pin icon and helper 'A field officer can help you capture this on-site.', small map preview card showing a dropped orange pin and captured coordinates 9.0833° N, 6.0167° E, Farm size (hectares) 12.4, Land ownership segmented (Owned / Leased / Family), Main crops chips (Maize selected, Rice, Soybean, Sugarcane, Vegetables, Cassava). Full-width dark 'Continue →' button.

title: Create Farmer ID — Step 3 Review & ID issued
prompt: Mobile success screen: step 3 of 3 all green. Large dark Farmer ID card (ink green, soft shadow): 'Farmer ID' label, badge 'NI-00284921', name 'Musa Danjuma', QR code tile, footer '12.4 Ha · Land active' and 'Bida · LGA'. Below: green check 'Your Farmer ID is ready' and caption 'Pending field verification — a field officer will visit within 7 days.' Summary list rows (Phone, Community, Farm, Crops) with edit links. Buttons: dark 'Go to Home', outline 'Download ID card'.

title: My Farms
prompt: Mobile 'My Farms' screen, back chevron, title, '+ Add farm' pill on the right. Summary stat row: '2 Farms', '18.9 Ha total', '1 Verified'. Farm cards (white, 1px border, 16px radius) each with a photo thumbnail of the field, farm name 'Farm 01 · Bida Basin', '12.4 Ha · White Maize · Outgrower', status pill 'Verified' (green) and a small progress bar 'Day 42 of 126'. Second card 'Farm 02 · Mokwa Plot', '6.5 Ha · Rice', status 'Pending verification' (gold). Dashed card 'Register another farm'. Bottom nav with Farm active.

title: Farm registration / location capture
prompt: Mobile 'Register farm' screen. Top half: satellite map of farmland with an orange boundary polygon being drawn, corner vertices as white dots, floating chip 'GPS accuracy ±4 m' and 'Walk the boundary' toggle. Floating buttons: 'Use my location', 'Undo point'. Bottom sheet (white, rounded top): computed area '12.4 ha', coordinates, fields Farm name, LGA dropdown, Soil type dropdown, Water source chips (Rain-fed, Irrigated, River), Upload farm photo tile. Dark 'Save farm' button.

title: Niger Foods announcements
prompt: Mobile 'Announcements' screen with filter chips (All, Programmes, Weather, Market prices, Inputs). Featured card: photo of maize harvest with dark scrim, tag 'NIGER FOODS', title 'Dry-season input loans now open', date. List of announcement cards: 'Weather advisory: heavy rain Thursday in Bida' with NEW badge and orange cloud icon; 'Maize off-take price: ₦520,000 / tonne at Bida Silo' with gold price tag; 'Fertilizer distribution at Mokwa hub — Sat 8 AM'. Each shows time ago and a chevron. Bottom nav Home active.

title: Agricultural programmes
prompt: Mobile 'Programmes' screen. Segmented tabs 'Open · My programmes'. Enrolled banner (dark card): 'Maize Outgrower 2025 — Active', progress 33%. Programme cards with image header: 'Rice Dry-Season Scheme' (Deadline Oct 15, 'Inputs + mechanization + guaranteed off-take', badges 'Rice', 'Loan'), 'Soybean Seed Multiplication', 'Youth Agripreneur Grant'. Each card shows eligibility check chip 'You're eligible' in green and 'View details' link. Bottom nav Services active.

title: Programme details + application
prompt: Mobile programme detail: hero image of rice paddies with back button, title 'Rice Dry-Season Scheme 2025', tags. Stat tiles: 'Up to ₦450,000 inputs', '5 ha max', 'Deadline Oct 15'. Sections: What you get (checklist: certified seed, fertilizer, tractor ploughing, guaranteed buy-back at Bida Silo), Requirements, Repayment. Application block: pre-filled Farmer ID card mini, select farm dropdown 'Farm 02 · Mokwa Plot', hectares to enroll stepper, consent checkbox. Sticky dark 'Apply now' button.

title: Services hub + Machinery services
prompt: Mobile 'Services' screen. Grid of 4 service tiles with line icons: Machinery, Inputs, Programmes, Field visit. Section 'MACHINERY' with cards: Tractor ploughing '₦35,000 / ha · Available Mon', Harrowing, Planter, Combine harvester 'Book for Oct', Sprayer. Each card: photo of machine, price, availability dot, 'Request' button. Top: 'Your bookings' dark card 'Tractor service · Slot confirmed (Morning) · Fri'. Bottom nav Services active.

title: Machinery request form
prompt: Mobile 'Request tractor' form. Machine summary card with photo 'Tractor ploughing · ₦35,000/ha'. Fields: Farm (dropdown Farm 01 · Bida Basin), Hectares 12.4, Preferred date (calendar strip of next 7 days, Friday selected), Time slot chips (Morning selected, Afternoon), Notes textarea, Payment option segmented (Deduct from harvest / Pay now). Cost breakdown card: 12.4 ha × ₦35,000 = ₦434,000, subsidy −₦130,200, Total ₦303,800 in bold. Dark 'Submit request' button.

title: Support / farmer requests
prompt: Mobile 'Support' screen. Two dark action cards: 'Bida Extension Hotline' with phone icon and white pill '0800-NIGER'; 'Ask Agrit' with mic icon, 'Hausa · Yoruba · English · Igbo', white pill 'Speak'. Button row: 'New request' (dark), 'Report pest' (outline). Section 'MY REQUESTS' list: 'Tractor service — Confirmed' (green), 'Field visit — Scheduled Fri' (gold), 'Fertilizer shortfall — In review' (orange), 'Pest: fall armyworm — Resolved' (grey). Each row with ID #RQ-1042, date, chevron.

title: Request details / status
prompt: Mobile request detail 'Fertilizer shortfall #RQ-1042'. Status pill 'In review'. Details card (Farm 01 · Bida Basin, Category Inputs, Submitted Jun 20, attached photo thumbnails). Vertical status timeline: Submitted (green check), Assigned to Field Officer Aisha Bello (green check), Visit scheduled Fri 10 AM (black current dot), Resolved (numbered grey). Assigned officer card with avatar, name, call and chat buttons. Message thread preview. Buttons: 'Add update', outline 'Cancel request'.

title: Scan result bottom sheet
prompt: Mobile plant scan result: top 40% camera image of a maize leaf with a green detection box; white bottom sheet with drag handle: 'Fall armyworm detected', confidence 92% bar in orange, severity pill 'Moderate'. Sections: What to do (3 numbered steps), Recommended input 'Emamectin benzoate — available at Mokwa hub', buttons 'Request field visit' (dark) and 'Save to farm log' (outline).

title: Field Officer dashboard
prompt: Mobile Field Officer home: 'Good morning, Aisha' + badge 'Field Officer · Bida Zone'. Stat tiles row: '14 Visits this week', '6 Pending verifications', '312 Farmers'. Dark card 'Today's route' with small map and 4 stops. 'WHAT YOU NEED TO DO' dark task cards: 'Verify Musa Danjuma — Farm 01 · 10:00 AM', 'Capture GPS — Farm 02 Mokwa', 'Follow-up: armyworm report #RQ-1042'. Quick actions grid: Register farmer, Register farm, Verify, Sync offline (badge '3 pending'). Offline indicator chip. Bottom nav: Home · Farmers · Visits · Profile.

title: Field Officer — register farmer
prompt: Mobile 'Register farmer' (assisted enrolment) step 1 of 3 progress. Capture photo circle with camera icon, NIN / BVN field with verify button, Full name, Phone, Gender segmented, Date of birth, Community, LGA dropdown, Preferred language chips (Hausa selected), Cooperative dropdown. Consent: 'Farmer gave verbal consent' checkbox + thumbprint capture tile. Offline badge 'Saved on device · will sync'. Dark 'Next: farm details' button.

title: Field Officer — farm registration + GPS
prompt: Mobile 'Map farm boundary' for field officer. Full-width satellite map with orange polygon being walked, live blue location dot, top chip 'Walking… 6 points', accuracy '±3 m'. Bottom panel: 'Area 12.4 ha · Perimeter 1.42 km', buttons 'Add point', 'Finish boundary'. Below: farmer mini card 'Musa Danjuma · NI-00284921', crop dropdown, planting date, 3 photo slots (north, center, south). Dark 'Save & continue'.

title: Farmer verification
prompt: Mobile 'Verify farmer' checklist screen. Header card with farmer photo, name Musa Danjuma, ID NI-00284921, 'Registered Jun 12 (self)'. Checklist items with toggles/check states: Identity matches NIN (green check), Phone confirmed via OTP (green), Farm location within 50 m of GPS (green, mini map), Farm size matches (12.4 declared / 12.1 measured, gold warning), Crop observed: White maize (green). Photo evidence strip. Notes field. Two buttons: 'Approve & verify' (dark, full) and 'Flag issue' (outline red).

title: Niger Foods management dashboard
prompt: Desktop web dashboard 1440px for Niger Foods. Left sidebar ink-green (#14201A) with logo seal, nav: Overview (active), Farmers, Farms & Map, Programmes, Requests, Machinery, Field Officers, Analytics, Settings. Top bar: search, 'Season 2025 · Wet' selector, notifications, admin avatar. KPI cards: Registered farmers 12,480 (+8.2%), Verified 9,114, Hectares under programme 38,620, Est. off-take 64,000 t, Open requests 142. Row: Niger State LGA map with farm density bubbles; 'Requests by status' stacked bar. Row: table 'Pending verifications' and 'Machinery utilisation' bar chart. White cards, 1px borders, 16px radius.

title: Farmer management
prompt: Desktop 'Farmers' page, same sidebar (Farmers active). Header with count '12,480 farmers', buttons 'Export CSV', dark '+ Add farmer'. Filter bar: search, LGA, Programme, Status (Verified/Pending/Flagged), Crop. Data table: avatar+name, Farmer ID, Phone, LGA, Farms, Hectares, Programme, Status pill, Registered by (Self/Officer name), actions. Right drawer open showing selected farmer 'Musa Danjuma': Farmer ID card, farms list, programme enrolments, request history, 'Verify' / 'Suspend' buttons.

title: Farm management / map
prompt: Desktop 'Farms & Map' page, sidebar (Farms & Map active). Large satellite map of Niger State farmland occupying 70% width with farm boundary polygons color-coded by crop (maize green, rice teal, soybean gold), clusters with counts, layer toggles (Crops, Verification status, NDVI health, Machinery). Right panel list of farms with search; selected farm card 'Farm 01 · Bida Basin · 12.4 ha · Day 42 of 126' with growth progress, soil moisture 68%, owner, officer, 'Open farm'.

title: Programme management
prompt: Desktop 'Programmes' page, sidebar (Programmes active). Programme cards grid with status (Active, Draft, Closed): 'Maize Outgrower 2025' (4,210 enrolled, 21,300 ha, budget used 62% bar), 'Rice Dry-Season Scheme' (Open · applications 1,184, deadline Oct 15), 'Soybean Seed Multiplication'. Dark '+ New programme'. Below: 'Applications — Rice Dry-Season Scheme' table with applicant, LGA, hectares, eligibility score, officer recommendation, status and Approve/Reject actions; bulk action bar.

title: Requests management
prompt: Desktop 'Requests' page, sidebar (Requests active). Kanban board with columns New (38), Assigned (51), Scheduled (27), Resolved (426): cards show type icon (Machinery, Inputs, Field visit, Pest), request ID, farmer name, LGA, age, priority tag (High in orange). Top filters: type, LGA, officer, SLA breached toggle. Right side panel for selected '#RQ-1042 Fertilizer shortfall' with timeline, assign officer dropdown, schedule date, internal notes, 'Mark resolved'.

title: Analytics / reporting
prompt: Desktop 'Analytics' page, sidebar (Analytics active). Date range + LGA + crop filters, 'Download report' button. KPI strip: Farmer growth, Verification rate 73%, Avg yield 3.1 t/ha, Payout disbursed ₦1.84B, Request SLA 91%. Charts: line chart farmer registrations by month (self vs officer-assisted), bar chart hectares by LGA (Bida, Mokwa, Lapai, Agaie, Wushishi), donut crop mix, table 'Top field officers' (visits, verifications, avg response time). Clean, restrained palette: ink green, accent green, gold, grey.
